speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions; can you tell me how long you have had these symptoms and if they appeared at the same time?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Septic Arthritis of the left wrist.

Given your recent camping trip in Minnesota and previous knee pain, I suspect Lyme disease has spread to your wrist. Can you confirm if you have had a tick bite, and do you recall a "bullseye" rash on your body?
